Pen Patat

Served at: Fete de Papa Zaka - Feast of the Farmer Loa

Serves 8-10Prep 25 minCook 1 hour 15 min to 1 hour 30 min

Pen Patat, also known as Pain Patate, is a beloved Haitian sweet potato pudding or bread, rich with coconut milk and warm spices. It is a comforting and nourishing dish, perfectly suited for the Fete de Papa Zaka, the Feast of the Farmer Loa. This celebration honors Azaka Mede, the spirit of agriculture and harvest, making a dish crafted from the bounty of the earth, like sweet potatoes, a traditional and heartfelt offering.

Ingredients

  • 3 pounds (1.4 kg) sweet potatoes, peeled and grated
  • 1 (13.5 ounce / 400 ml) can full-fat coconut milk
  • 1 (12 ounce / 354 ml) can evaporated milk
  • 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar (or more, to taste)
  • 1/2 cup (113 g) unsalted butter, melted
  • 1/4 cup (30 g) all-purpose flour
  • 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
  • 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
  • 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger
  • Pinch of ground cloves
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup (75 g) raisins (optional)
  • 1 teaspoon lime zest (optional)

Method

  1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x13 inch (23x33 cm) baking dish.
  2. In a large mixing bowl, combine the grated sweet potatoes, coconut milk, evaporated milk, granulated sugar, melted butter, all-purpose flour, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, ground ginger, ground cloves, vanilla extract, and salt.
  3. Stir all ingredients thoroughly until well combined and the flour is fully incorporated.
  4. If using, fold in the raisins and lime zest.
  5. Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish, spreading it evenly.
  6. Bake for 1 hour 15 minutes to 1 hour 30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and a knife inserted into the center comes out mostly clean.
  7. Remove from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving. Pen Patat can be served warm or at room temperature.

Tips

  • For a smoother consistency, you can blend about half of the grated sweet potatoes in a food processor before mixing with other ingredients.
  • Adjust the amount of sugar to your preference; some sweet potatoes are naturally sweeter than others.
  • Pen Patat can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3-4 days.
